'''''Cololejeunea''''' is a genus of liverworts in the family [[Lejeuneaceae]].

They have a [[cosmopolitan distribution]] worldwide.<ref name=GBIF/>

The [[GBIF]] lists up to 534 species (as of June 2023),<ref name=GBIF>{{cite web |title=''Cololejeunea'' (Spruce) Schiffn. |url=https://www.gbif.org/species/2688776 |website=www.gbif.org |access-date=29 June 2023 |language=en}}</ref> whereas [[World Flora Online]] lists only 494 results.<ref>{{cite web |title=Search |url=http://www.worldfloraonline.org/search?query=Cololejeunea |website=www.worldfloraonline.org |access-date=29 June 2023}}</ref> 
See [[List of Cololejeunea species]] for GBIF list of species.
